subtitle: Shapes, kit, weather
question: What shape can only you make?
promise: In this unit you will invent shapes with your body, let the kit give you ideas, and move like the weather.
learn: Use a hoop for an idea

title: Shapes you invent
text: Stand tall like a tree. Curl small like a stone. Stretch long like a bridge. Your body can make any shape you think of.
say: Ask for one shape at a time, and let the class hold it while you count to three.

text: The wind makes shapes too. Watch the leaves go.

title: What can a hoop do?
text: Pick up a hoop. Make a shape with it. Try three different shapes.
ask: Draw the best shape you made with the hoop.

words.meaning: wind, rain, sun - and how they move

text: Be the weather. Make a wind shape, then a rain shape, then a sun shape. Hold each one while a partner watches.

title: Show an answer
text: Listen to the word. Answer with your body, not your voice.
Rain makes every shape the same shape. Water finds the low place.
